title: 第531章 濒死之镜第530章 主君之威
lines: 去‘翠微天’！
那里有我族圣木，可暂保他一线生机！”
青帝的声音嘶哑而急促，带着前所未有的慌乱。
他双手不断结印，翠绿色的生命法则如丝如缕，不要钱般涌入云澈那残破不堪的躯体，勉强维系着那即将彻底断绝的生机。
冥皇与羽曦一左一右，各自展开领域，抵御着后方可能追击而来的零星吞噬族，以及战场边缘混乱的能量乱流。
他们不敢在危机四伏的前线久留，更不敢返回拥挤嘈杂的万界枢纽。
青帝当机立断，凭借着木族在诸界星域遗留的些许古老联系，感应到一处名为“翠微天”
的隐秘世界坐标。
那里曾是木族某位先贤开辟的避世之所，虽已荒废，但应存有强大的生命阵法和一株枯萎的圣木残骸，或许能为云澈争取到宝贵的疗伤时间。
三人带着昏迷垂死的云澈，不惜耗费本源，连续进行超远距离空间穿梭，终于摆脱了战区范围，来到一片相对平静的星域边缘。
按照古老星图指引，他们合力撕开一层极其隐秘的空间褶皱，眼前豁然开朗。
这是一方并不算广袤，却生机异常浓郁的小世界。
天空是柔和的翡翠色，大地铺满厚厚的、散发清香的灵藓，远处有飞瀑流泉，灵禽异兽隐现。
世界中心，一株高达万丈、通体晶莹如碧玉、却枝叶凋零、气息衰败的参天古木巍然矗立，正是那枯萎的圣木。
尽管枯萎，其残留的磅礴生命气息，依旧让重伤的三人精神一振。
来不及探查，青帝立刻寻到圣木根部一处天然形成的生命灵池，将云澈小心翼翼放入其中。
灵池之水呈乳白色，蕴含精纯的生命元力，虽因圣木枯萎而效果大减，却也远胜寻常灵药。
“劳烦两位道友护法！”
青帝对冥皇、羽曦说了一句，便盘坐于灵池边，双手按在云澈心口与眉心，翠绿光芒大盛。
他直接引动了木族本源，沟通这枯萎圣木残存的最后一点灵性，配合灵池水，构建一个强大的生命封禁，将云澈最后一点游离的真灵与破碎的肉身强行“锁”
住，吊住那口气。
冥皇默然点头，盘坐于灵池另一侧，幽深的死亡气息弥散开来，并非毁灭，而是以一种极端的方式，平衡、镇压着云澈体内因伤势过重、濒临崩溃而产生的各种“死气”
与“异力”
，防止其进一步恶化。
生死相克，亦能相生，此刻冥皇以无上死寂之意，强行维持着云澈体内那微妙的生死平衡，使其不至于立刻滑向彻底的死亡。
羽曦则身化流光，守护在小世界入口处，同时以其无与伦比的极速，不断穿梭于小世界内外，采集一些对疗伤可能有用的稀有灵粹，或者警惕可能出现的任何威胁。
她的速度在此刻发挥了最大作用。
时间一天天过去。
云澈的状况依旧危如累卵，没有丝毫好转的迹象。
他如同一个布满裂痕、即将彻底破碎的瓷器，被青帝以生命法则和圣木残力强行粘合在一起，但内部早已千疮百孔。
他的身躯惨不忍睹。
骨骼尽碎，许多地方完全化为齑粉，只能依靠生命法则勉强维持人形。
经脉寸断，如同被暴力扯断的琴弦，杂乱地纠缠在破碎的脏腑间。
五脏六腑没有一处完好，有的甚至缺失了大半，被翠绿的生命力勉强模拟出形态。
皮肤上布满了蛛网般的裂痕，不时有黯淡的银灰色血液渗出，那是他本源精血流失殆尽的征兆。
最严重的是体内。
丹田之中，那原本巍峨神圣、缠绕时光长河、光暗轮转的“天命法相”
，此刻黯淡无光，布满了密密麻麻的裂痕，仿佛随时会彻底崩解消散。
content_en:
"Quick!
Go to ‘Cuiweitian’!
There is our clan's sacred tree there, which can temporarily save his life! "
Qingdi's voice was hoarse and rapid, with unprecedented panic.
He kept forming seals with his hands, and the emerald-green law of life poured into Yun Che's dilapidated body like threads, barely keeping the vitality that was about to be completely cut off.
Pluto Emperor and Yu Xi, one on the left and the other on the right, expanded their respective areas to resist the sporadic Devouring Tribes that might pursue them from behind, as well as the chaotic energy flow at the edge of the battlefield.
They dare not stay long on the crisis-ridden frontline, let alone return to the crowded and noisy Hub of All Realms.
Qingdi made a prompt decision and relied on some ancient connections left by the Wood clan in the star fields of all realms to sense a place called "Cuiwei Tian"
The hidden world coordinates.
It was once a refuge opened by a certain sage of the Wood Clan. Although it was abandoned, there should be a powerful life formation and the remains of a withered sacred tree, which might buy Yun Che precious time to heal.
The three of them took Yun Che, who was unconscious and dying, and continued to travel through ultra-long-distance space at all costs, finally escaping from the war zone and arriving at the edge of a relatively calm star field.
Following the guidance of the ancient star map, they worked together to tear apart an extremely secretive layer of space folds, and their eyes suddenly became clear.
This is a small world that is not very vast, but extremely vibrant.
The sky is a soft emerald color, the ground is covered with thick, fragrant spiritual moss, there are waterfalls and springs in the distance, and spiritual birds and animals are looming.
In the center of the world, a towering ancient tree with a height of ten thousand feet and a body as crystal as jade stands majestically, but its branches and leaves are withered and its breath is decaying. It is the withered sacred tree.
Even though it was withered, its remaining majestic breath of life still refreshed the spirits of the three seriously injured people.
Without having time to investigate, Qingdi immediately found a naturally formed life spirit pool at the root of the sacred tree, and carefully placed Yun Che into it.
The water of the spiritual pool is milky white and contains pure life force. Although the effect is greatly reduced due to the withering of the holy wood, it is still far better than ordinary elixirs.
"Excuse me, my two fellow Taoists, to protect the Dharma!"
Qing Emperor said something to Minghuang and Yu Xi, then sat cross-legged by the spiritual pool, placed his hands on Yun Che's heart and between his eyebrows, and the emerald green light flourished.
He directly triggered the origin of the Wood Clan, communicated with the last remaining spirituality of the withered sacred wood, and cooperated with the water of the spiritual pool to construct a powerful life seal, forcibly "locking" Yun Che's last free true spirit and broken body.
Hold on, hold on to that breath.
The Underworld Emperor nodded silently and sat cross-legged on the other side of the spiritual pool. The deep aura of death spread out. It was not destruction, but an extreme way to balance and suppress the various "death auras" generated in Yun Che's body due to excessive injuries and the verge of collapse.
and "different force"
, to prevent further deterioration.
Even if life and death are in conflict with each other, they can also create each other. At this moment, the Emperor of Hades used the supreme silence of death to forcefully maintain the delicate balance of life and death in Yun Che's body, preventing him from immediately sliding into complete death.
Yu Xi transformed into a stream of light, guarding the entrance to the small world. At the same time, with her unparalleled speed, she constantly shuttled inside and outside the small world, collecting some rare spiritual essence that might be useful for healing, or to be wary of any threats that might arise.
Her speed was at its best at this moment.
Time passes day by day.
Yun Che's condition is still very critical and shows no signs of improvement.
He was like a porcelain full of cracks and about to be completely broken. The Qing Emperor used the law of life and the remaining power of the sacred wood to forcefully glue it together, but the inside was already riddled with holes.
His body was in terrible shape.
The bones were completely broken, and many places were completely turned into powder. He could only rely on the law of life to barely maintain his human form.
The meridians were broken, like strings torn apart by violence, and they were messily entangled among the broken organs.
None of the internal organs were intact, and some were even missing most of them, barely able to take their shape from the emerald green vitality.
The skin was covered with spiderweb-like cracks, and dim silver-gray blood seeped out from time to time. This was a sign that his original essence and blood had been exhausted.
The most serious thing is inside the body.
In the Dantian, the original majestic and sacred "Destiny Dharma" entwines the long river of time and rotates between light and darkness.
, it was dim and dull at the moment, covered with dense cracks, as if it would completely disintegrate and dissipate at any time.
